subject: SOC 2 Type II report access & trust portal request (post-call)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@healthbridge.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report access & trust portal request (post-call)

Hi Alice — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can unblock your InfoSec review: 

Summary of what we discussed
- Scope: You confirmed production data will be processed for the analytics integration; HIPAA applicability is likely (covered PHI) and GDPR is in scope for EU users.
- Current posture: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for 2025; we maintain a Trust Portal with evidence and bridge letters for the gap period.
- VSQ: You’d like to kick off the vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) and get answers + evidence.

Ask / proposed next steps
1) Please grant the email vendor@redwood.ai access to HealthBridge's trust portal (or share a portal invite link) so we can upload a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter.
2) I’ll attach our SOC 2 Type II PDF and a standard bridge letter for your records (see attachments). If you need us to upload directly into your portal instead, tell me which URL and the inviter email to use.
3) We can start the VSQ — I’ve attached our VSQ template to accelerate mapping questions to evidence. If you prefer, send your questionnaire and we’ll populate it by EOD Friday.
4) Technical: CC’d Dev to answer any architecture/crypto questions; Monica from Security Ops will handle evidence uploads and redaction requirements.

Timeline we’re proposing
- Today: Grant portal access or share link + any immediate must-have evidence list.
- 2 business days: We’ll upload SOC2 PDF + bridge letter and populate initial VSQ responses.
- 5 business days: Complete responses and provide any additional artifacts you request.

If this all sounds right I’ll wait for the portal invite and your VSQ (or I’ll start with our template once you confirm). Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2025.pdf (stub), Bridge-Letter-Redwood-2025.pdf (stub), Vendor-Security-Questionnaire-template.xlsx (stub)

From: Alice Kim <alice.kim@healthbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report access & trust portal request (post-call)

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear recap and the timeline. Confirming a few items from our side and next actions: 

1) Trust portal: We can invite vendor@redwood.ai to our vendor portal. It will grant access to uploads and comments (no admin rights). I’ll ask our security admin to issue the invite today; you should see it from security@healthbridge.com.
2) VSQ: We have a short vendor security questionnaire (25 Qs) and a DPA addendum. I’ll attach a copy in a follow-up. If you can start with your template, that would speed things up — I’ll mark any gaps.
3) HIPAA/GDPR: We need to confirm whether Redwood will act as a Business Associate under HIPAA for any PHI processing; please include your BAA status in the bridge letter or provide pointer to the legal contact. For GDPR, confirm subprocessor list and EU data residency options.

Can you also confirm whether we need a separate redacted report for regulatory review (we typically want a version without customer names and IPs)? If so, can you indicate which fields will be redacted?

I’ll keep an eye out for the portal invite and your populated VSQ template. Thanks,

— Alice
Alice Kim
Head of Information Security
HealthBridge Analytics
alice.kim@healthbridge.com | +1 (646) 555-0123

(Will follow up with the portal invite from security@healthbridge.com shortly.)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@healthbridge.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 07:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report access & trust portal request (post-call)

Thanks, Alice — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifications below: 

HIPAA / BAA
- Redwood signs a standard BAA for customers processing PHI. Our legal team can send the BAA and we can include a reference in the bridge letter. I’ll loop Legal if you want the doc sooner.

Redaction guidance
- Typical redactions we apply: customer names, customer-specific network/IPs, production credential values, full UUIDs for customer assets. We do not redact control descriptions, tests performed, or auditor findings. If you need additional redactions, let me know and Monica will handle.

Subprocessors & EU residency
- Subprocessor list and EU region hosting options are included in the appendix of the SOC 2 and on our trust portal. We’ll point you to the exact section once access is granted.

Portal invite / upload plan
- If you receive an invite from security@healthbridge.com, please accept and then let us know. Monica will upload the SOC2 PDF and the bridge letter and set file-level comments for any follow-up artifacts.

Next steps (short):
- Alice: send the portal invite to vendor@redwood.ai (or forward the invite link).
- HealthBridge: share the VSQ doc if you prefer us to fill yours; otherwise we’ll start with our template and send the populated file by EOD Friday.
- Redwood: we’ll attach our BAA template to the VSQ packet and include legal contact details.

If helpful, I can schedule a quick follow-up call with Monica and Dev to walk through the technical evidence items.

Best,
Soojin
